title: Learning Memory Record
description: One immutable unit of durable knowledge or evidence. The source from which derived views are rebuilt. See docs/08 Memory Architecture.md.

kind.description: A summary is derived and rebuildable; all other kinds are primary observations.

layer.description: Which memory layer owns this record. Working context is session-bounded and never persisted here.

derived.description: True for records computed from other records. Retrieval MUST label these so a summary is never mistaken for an observation.

source_event_id.description: The validated event that produced this record. A record without a source event is not persistable.

derived_from.description: memory_ids this record summarises. Required when derived is true.

evidence_at.description: When the underlying evidence occurred. Drives contradiction resolution under Constitution C5.

confidence.description: Below memory.min_confidence_durable, the candidate is rejected for durable storage.

provenance.description: Required for externally sourced and current-affairs claims. Without it, the claim is ineligible for durable memory.

contradicts.description: memory_ids this record conflicts with. Both records are retained; resolution follows Constitution C5.

superseded_by.description: Set when newer, higher-quality evidence replaces this record. The record itself is never deleted or rewritten.
